classification_threshold: argmax(p0, p1), identical to the frozen prediction label
cross_task_combination_rule: directions are reported separately in script 82
label_mapping: raw levels 0-1 = class 0; raw levels 2-3 = class 1

metric_definitions.average_precision: step-wise average precision; reported separately from trapezoidal PR-AUC
metric_definitions.brier_score: mean squared error between p(class 1) and the binary label
metric_definitions.calibration_intercept_slope: joint logistic calibration fit on clipped prediction logits with C=1e6
metric_definitions.ece_5_bins: recording-count-weighted absolute calibration gap in five fixed-width bins
metric_definitions.log_loss: mean negative natural log probability assigned to the true class; probabilities clipped to 1e-12
metric_definitions.pr_auc: trapezoidal area under the precision-recall curve

statistical_unit_for_inference: participant; inference is deferred to script 83
